- SFCC-84: "Recently Viewed - See Full History" — a new page behind a "See Full History" link from that rail.

Extract and report back ONLY what bears on building these, specifically:
1. Any guidance on building a NEW PAGE under `overrides/app/pages/` (routing, page structure, data fetching, `getProps`, SSR vs client-only).
2. Any guidance on client-side persistence / localStorage / sessionStorage / customer-attribute storage, and anything about browsing-history or personalisation state.
3. Any guidance on horizontal rails / carousels / scrollers / product-scroller patterns.
4. Guidance on data-fetching hooks (`@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react`), container vs presentational split, and where mappers (product API response → component props) should live.
5. Anything on tests/stories requirements for a new page vs a new component.
6. Anything about consent gating third-party or tracking features.

For each item: quote the relevant passage verbatim (with its heading/section so I can cite structure, NOT line numbers unless stable), and note any `file:line` citation it makes that you can verify no longer resolves in `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa` (check a sample of them).

Also explicitly report: anything in the handbook that CONTRADICTS `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md` or `.claude/rules/components.md` (read both to compare). The repo rules win — I need to know where the handbook is stale.

Return a structured report. Do not edit any file.

105	### 1. How a value resolves
106	
107	#### The pipeline is one-way
108	
109	```
110	theme/foundation/*.ts   ← source of truth (Tier 1)
111	        ↓
112	zimmTokens.ts           ← DERIVED. Never hand-edit.
113	        ↓
114	--zimm-* CSS custom properties
115	        ↓
116	recipes: <name>.css.ts / theme/components/*.ts
117	        ↓
118	component JSX
119	```
120	
121	`zimmTokens.ts` imports `colors`/`spacing`/`fontSizes`/`lineHeights`/`letterSpacings`/
122	`fontWeights`/`iconSizes`/`actionSizes`/`motion`/`grid` from their owning files rather than
123	retyping values. The only literals left in it are 7 numeric `--zimm-scale-NNN` aliases with
124	no named-scale equivalent.
125	
126	**A Tier 1 comment is wrong about those 7.** `theme/index.ts:47` says the 15 numeric aliases
127	*"are duplicates of the named scale."* `overrideStyling.md:83-85` says 7 of them are not, and
128	`overrideStyling.md` is right: `025` (1px), `700` (28px), `1100` (44px), `1200` (48px),
129	`1300` (52px), `3500` (140px), `4500` (180px) are hardcoded in `zimmTokens.ts`; the other 8
130	derive from `spacing`.
131	
132	#### The registration reality — this is the one that breaks layouts
133	
134	`theme/index.ts` registers the Zimmermann scale as **`space` only** (line 56). `sizes`,
135	`fontSizes`, `lineHeights` and `letterSpacings` are deliberately **not** registered, because
136	registering them would restyle the base retail-react-app at ~199 call sites.
137	
138	| Prop family | Reads | Bare key like `'xl'` |
139	|---|---|---|
140	| `margin` `padding` `gap` | `theme.space` ✅ registered | correct |
141	| `width` `height` `boxSize` `min/maxWidth/Height` | `theme.sizes` ❌ not registered | **falls through to Chakra's defaults** |
142	| `fontSize` `lineHeight` `letterSpacing` | ❌ not registered | wrong value, or nothing |
143	
144	Measured blow-up range: **8×–112×**. `width: 'xl'` resolves through `theme.sizes.xl` = 36rem
145	= **576px** — that shipped, blew the footer contact icons to 576px, and destroyed the layout
146	on every page. Worse: `s`, `m`, `l` are **absent** from Chakra's `sizes`, so those
147	declarations are dropped entirely and silently.
148	
149	Typography has the same twin. `fontSize: '2xs'` emits 0.625rem where 0.875rem was intended;
150	`fontSize: '4xs'` emits nothing at all.
151	
152	**Live unfixed instance:** `overrides/app/components/header/index.tsx:311` has `fontSize="l"`,
153	which emits nothing. Pre-existing, out of scope for every PR that has touched that file since.
154	`recipeGuards.test.ts` cannot reach it — it walks the registered recipe map only, and this is
155	a JSX prop. Its own `SCOPE:` note says so.
156	
157	**The rule:** on a sizing or typography prop, always the CSS var —
158	`width: 'var(--zimm-scale-xl)'`, never `width: 'xl'`. Spacing props are fine with bare keys as
159	far as *correctness* goes; house style is a separate question, below.
160	
161	#### [CORRECTED] `var(--zimm-*)` in component JSX is now required, not a smell
162	
163	An earlier revision of this document said component JSX should use `textStyle` plus semantic
164	token strings (`color="text.default"`, `padding="m"`), and that seeing `var()` in a `.tsx` was
165	a signal to look closer. **That is inverted from the current rule and following it now fails
166	review.**
167	
168	`overrideStyling.md` hierarchy point 2 and `css.md` both state it plainly:
169	
170	```tsx
171	// ❌ a bare Chakra/theme token string
172	<Box color="text.default" padding="m" />
173	
174	// ✅ the raw var(--zimm-*) reference
175	<Box color="var(--zimm-color-text-default)" padding="var(--zimm-scale-m)" />
176	```
177	
178	The stated reason is **house style, not correctness**: a bare key resolves to the identical
179	value on a registered scale, but it forces a reviewer to check `theme/index.ts`'s
180	registered-scale list to know whether it happens to be correct. A `var()` reference is
181	unambiguous at every call site.
182	
183	`textStyle` is the one legitimate bare key — there is no `var()` for the composite expansion,
184	only for its individual pieces.
185	
186	**And it can never emit one.** `zimmTokens.ts` imports *from* `typography.ts`, so the reverse
187	would be a circular import; `textStyle` therefore always expands to resolved literals at build
188	time. **This is correct behaviour, not a defect** — and it means roughly **85% of what an
189	emitted-CSS audit flags as "raw literals" is `textStyle` working as designed.** Read any
190	`audit:tokens` output with that in mind.
191	
192	**What survives from the old advice, and is still the main point:** brand values mostly should
193	not be in JSX at all. Re-measured on `develop` @ `269d5d4` (2026-08-29) — `var(--zimm-*)` appears in **21
194	theme files** (17 co-located `<name>.css.ts` + 4 under `theme/components/`), up from 14 as the
195	PDP work landed, and in **two** production component `.tsx` files:
196	`footer/footerNavColumn/index.tsx:44,62`, a conditional `paddingLeft` that no Chakra prop
197	expresses, and `pages/product-detail/partials/staticProductHeader.tsx`. It also appears in two
198	`.stories.tsx`, `theme/index.test.tsx` and `theme/zimmTokensGlobal.tsx` — stories, tests and the
199	token emitter itself are not violations and should not be counted as such. So the practice is: type via `textStyle`,
200	colour and spacing into the recipe, `var()` in JSX only for a genuine prop-system gap.
201	
202	**[CORRECTED] The two violations named in the 25 Aug pass are fixed.**
203	`zimmProductName` and `zimmProductModelInfo` now carry no style prop at all — both route
204	everything through their `.css.ts` recipe, and `zimmProductModelInfo/index.tsx` says so in a
205	docblock. The only `text.default` left in `ui-kits` is `zimmLogo/index.tsx:23`, which reads it
206	through `useToken` — the token API, not a raw literal, and not a violation.
207	
208	**Live violations right now** (`npm run audit:tokens`, 2026-08-29) are all in the header
209	surface: `header/index.tsx:238` `'240px'`, `theme/components/header.ts:73` `'597px'` and `:74`
210	`'70px'`, and `theme/components/navConstants.ts:5` `'0.02em'`.
211	
212	#### Value equality is not token equality
213	
214	Before replacing a literal with a token, three checks — all three must pass:
215	
216	1. **Same unit?** `rem` and `px` are not interchangeable. Swapping `3rem` for a px-defined
217	   alias is a **WCAG 1.4.4 regression**, not a tidy-up.
218	2. **Same semantic scale?** A spacing value and a sizing value that happen to be equal are not
219	   the same token.
220	3. **Is the target permitted?** The numeric `--zimm-scale-NNN` aliases are **class-only** —
221	   never in JSX or a recipe.
222	
223	Three real false positives died on these: `SPACE_SECTION = '3rem'` → `--zimm-scale-1200`
224	(check 1), `SIZE_COL_NAV` (check 2), and `SIZE_MODAL_SUB` ≡ `breakpoints.sm`, which was pure
225	coincidence.
226	
227	#### The real invariant is single-sourcing, not `var()` syntax
228	
229	Ask of any value: *is this typed more than once?* Not: *is this a `var()`?* An audit built on
230	syntax generates mostly noise.
231	
232	PR #56 reduced `foundation/`'s hand-typed literals from 237 to 64 — **173 were duplicates**,
233	the same `24px` appearing in `typography.ts` and again in `zimmTokens.ts`. Two later PRs
234	recreated that duplication one layer up without noticing: PR #52 hand-rebuilt in `sx` what
235	`textStyle="heading3"` already gave, five times; PR #55 added `cssVars.ts`, 241 lines mirroring
236	`zimmTokens.ts`'s keys as `var()` strings plus a reimplementation of seven registered text
237	styles. It was removed — a 245-line deletion; at its peak it had 10 consumer files and 148 references.
238	
239	Both misreads passed CodeRabbit. It confirmed every correctness finding and raised **zero**
240	architecture findings.
241	
242	#### Units
243	
244	- **`rem`** for anything that should scale with root font-size or browser zoom (WCAG 1.4.4) —
245	  type and spacing. Sub-pixel letter-spacing values keep a trailing `// -0.12px` comment for
246	  traceability, since they don't round to clean rem.
247	- **`px`** for hairline geometry that should *not* scale — border widths, focus-ring offsets.
248	- **`em`** only for breakpoints (`gridSystem.ts`, deliberate so media queries shift with zoom)
249	  and other genuinely context-relative cases. Not a general-purpose unit.

253	### 2. Chakra behaviours that fail silently
254	
255	Seven mechanisms. None produces an error, a warning, or a failing type-check.
256	
257	**0. Always declare your own `parts` array.** A recipe with no `parts` inherits the base's
258	list, so any Zimmermann part you add is undeclared and silently unstyled.
259	
260	**1. `extendTheme` deep-merges — it does not replace.** A recipe named `Footer` merges into
261	base SFCC's `Footer` rather than replacing it, inheriting parts you never wrote. Namespace
262	everything: `ZimmFooter`, not `Footer`. `recipeGuards.test.ts` enforces this with
263	`INTENTIONAL_MERGES = ['Button', 'Header', 'ListMenu']` — those three are deliberate; anything
264	else must be namespaced.
265	
266	**1b. The merge reorders keys.** A key that already exists in the base keeps the **base's**
267	position in the merged object; a key you add that the base lacks is appended **last**. That is
268	the mechanism behind a shorthand resetting a longhand you wrote first — the order in your file
269	is not the order that ships. Inspect what actually applies:
270	
271	```js
272	theme.components.Header.baseStyle   // merged — what actually applies
273	```
274	
275	**2. A recipe unit test cannot catch the merge.** `extendTheme` does **not** populate
276	`theme.__cssMap` — only `ChakraProvider` does, via `toCSSVar`. So a direct `css()(theme)`
277	assertion in Vitest passes vacuously against an unmerged object.
278	
279	**3. Compound values never tokenise.** Chakra resolves a token only as the **entire** value.
280	`padding: 'xs 0'` is emitted verbatim and dropped by the browser. Use axis props
281	(`paddingInline`, `paddingBlock`).
282	
283	**4. A shorthand declared after a longhand resets it.** `padding: 0` after `paddingBlock`
284	wipes it. Order matters; prefer the axis props throughout.
285	
286	**5. `IconButton` hard-sets `padding: "0"`** as a style prop, merged *after* `__css`, so a `p:`
287	in your recipe size is discarded. **Size it with `minW`/`minH`** — which is also how you hit the
288	24×24 target-size requirement.
289	
290	**6. Register the recipe or destructuring throws at runtime.** Chakra resolves a recipe by the
291	string key passed to `useMultiStyleConfig`, not by file path — so co-location is free, but the
292	key must be in `theme/components/index.ts`.
293	
294	**7. Breakpoint tokens conflict with Chakra's.** `BP.desktop` is 64em; Chakra's `lg` is 62em
295	and `xl` is 80em. A responsive array silently steps at the wrong width. Write explicit media
296	queries:
297	
298	```ts
299	[`@media (min-width: ${BP.tablet})`]: { gap: 'var(--zimm-scale-3xl)' },
300	```
301	
302	The array shorthand also puts a bare token key at every step, and the guard flags all four.

306	### 3. Component structure
307	
308	#### Placement — settled
309	
310	```
311	overrides/app/components/ui-kits/{atoms,molecules,organisms}/<camelCase>/index.tsx
312	```
313	
314	Being under `components/` is load-bearing for the registry generator, which scans that path.
315	
316	**Three casing families, each correct in its own context. Do not generalise between them:**
317	
318	| Family | Casing | Why |
319	|---|---|---|
320	| SFCC override | `product-tile/` kebab | must match upstream's import path |
321	| ui-kit component | `zimmButton/` camelCase | Zimmermann-authored — the default rule |
322	| `shared/ui` primitive | `Button/` PascalCase | mirrors upstream exactly |
323	
324	Kebab-case applies *only* to files mirroring a base Salesforce file. Note the theme key is
325	PascalCase (`ZimmTextInput`) while its recipe file is camelCase.
326	
327	#### Tier is by composition, not visual size
328	
329	Read it off the imports, not the DOM:
330	
331	- **atom** — imports no other ui-kit. `zimmModal` is an atom despite being portal + backdrop +
332	  `role="dialog"` chrome, because it owns no content (`maxWidth`, `labelledBy`, children all
333	  come from the caller).
334	- **molecule** — composes atoms with light local logic. `zimmInputAction` = TextInput + Button
335	  + local validation state.
336	- **organism** — composes molecules/atoms **and owns domain state**. `zimmSubscribeSection`
337	  owns the subscribe state machine.
338	
339	An icon passed as a prop doesn't count (`icon="close"` keeps a Button an atom). Slotted
340	children don't count.
341	
342	**Storybook `title` is a different axis from the folder.** Folder = composition depth;
343	`title` = domain. `zimmModal` (atom) → `Elements/`; `zimmSubscribeSection` (organism) →
344	`Forms/`; `Footer` → `Layout/`. Don't conflate them.
345	
346	#### Styling surface — a registered recipe, always
347	
348	Not inline styles, not a `.zimm-*` class, not a plain stylesheet. The recipe may live beside
349	the component as `<name>.css.ts` or centrally in `theme/components/` — Chakra resolves by
350	string key, so this is purely organisational.
351	
352	The argument against authoring in a stylesheet is worth keeping: a stylesheet can only see
353	`var(--zimm-*)`, which is **derived output at the bottom of the pipeline**. Author there and
354	you lose `textStyle`, the named `theme.space` scale, semantic colour tokens, and the theme
355	drift-guard tests. Not bad CSS — the wrong end of the pipeline.
356	
357	For a bespoke component wrapping a native element, the `chakra()` factory is the bridge:
358	native semantics plus recipe styling, read via `useMultiStyleConfig`.
359	
360	**Co-location changes who reviews it.** `CODEOWNERS:186`
361	(`overrides/app/components/**/*.css.ts` → squads only) is placed **last** among the
362	`components/` rules, and CODEOWNERS is last-match-wins, not most-specific-wins. So a `.css.ts`
363	inside `footer/` drops the Tier 2 approver requirement the surrounding directory carries,
364	while `footer/index.tsx` keeps it. The stated rationale: a co-located recipe *composes
365	established tokens*; authoring a new token still means `theme/foundation/` (Tier 1).
366	
367	`overrideStyling.md` flags its own inconsistency here rather than papering over it —
368	`zimmButton.css.ts` keys the app-wide `Button` recipe and is no longer designer-gated.
369	
370	#### No data-fetching in `components/`
371	
372	Anything under `overrides/app/components/` receives data as props. Data-fetching belongs in
373	`overrides/app/pages/` or a container.
374	
375	**One documented exception:** Context-backed, app-wide static-content hooks (`useIntl`,
376	`useUiCopy`) may be called from any component including presentational leaves, because they
377	read from a Provider mounted above the route tree. Narrow by design — content identical for
378	every consumer regardless of route, not anything that varies per page.
379	
380	**Their no-Provider behaviour differs, and it matters for tests.** `useUiCopy` degrades:
381	`useContext(UiCopyContext) ?? FALLBACK_ONLY`, one line, renders with zero setup. **`useIntl`
382	throws** (`invariantIntlContext`), and its `IntlProvider` is mounted by the base SFCC `_app`,
383	not `_app-config` — a strictly narrower subtree. Any Vitest test rendering a `useIntl` consumer
384	must wrap it.
385	
386	#### Two API patterns worth copying
387	
388	- **Encode the a11y contract in a discriminated union** so an inaccessible combination doesn't
389	  type-check.
390	- **Make an absent affordance opt-in**, not a silent default.
391	
392	#### Do not trust the registry's tier column
393	
394	`generateRegistry.mjs:133-215` hardcodes tier arrays (`TIER1_PATHS` at `:133`, `TIER2_PATHS`
395	at `:148`, squads at `:178`/`:192`), lists no `ui-kits` path, and defaults everything else to
396	Tier 4. The registry is auto-generated and its *paths* are reliable; its
397	*tier* column is not.

867	## Part II — FED Build Manual: Manual UI Build & Delivery
868	
869	*The sequenced procedure for taking a Zimmermann UI story from session start to merged PR.*
870	
871	*Source: `fedBuild-manual.md`*
872	
873	**Owner:** Marcel Navarro · **Started:** August 2026 · **Revised:** 25 August 2026
874	
875	The developer-facing half. This is the sequenced procedure for taking a Zimmermann UI story
876	from session start to merged PR.
877	
878	
879	**Authority on styling:** `.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md`. If this manual and that file
880	disagree, **that file wins** — and tell me, because it means this one is stale.
881	
882	---
883	
884	### 1. The Operating Principles
885	
886	#### Static-first
887	
888	Props in, markup out. A component under `overrides/app/components/` receives its data and
889	renders it. It does not fetch.
890	
891	Mock data goes in the story — never a temporary fetch you intend to remove. A component that
892	owns its own data-fetching cannot be reused where the data arrives differently: SSR-prefetched,
893	mocked in Storybook, or composed by a parent that already has it.
894	
895	**The one exception**, and it is narrow: Context-backed, app-wide static-content hooks
896	(`useIntl`, `useUiCopy`) may be called from any component, including a presentational leaf.
897	They read from a Provider mounted above the route tree, so they don't create the
898	SSR/Storybook/composition problem the rule exists to prevent. This covers content identical for
899	every consumer regardless of route — not anything that varies per page.
900	
901	⚠️ **Their no-Provider behaviour differs and it will bite you in tests.** `useUiCopy` degrades
902	to fallback text and renders with zero setup. **`useIntl` throws**, and its `IntlProvider` is
903	mounted by the base SFCC `_app`, not `_app-config` — a narrower subtree than you'd expect. Any
904	Vitest test rendering a `useIntl` consumer must wrap it.
905	
906	#### Leverage what already exists
907	
908	Four rungs, in order:
909	
910	1. **Use the base SFCC component as-is.**
911	2. **Override it** — mirror the path under `overrides/`, keep the kebab-case filename.
912	
913	**The default is override, not build — because an override inherits the wiring for free.**
914	Override `product-view` and you get `addToCart([{product, variant, quantity}])`, the
915	add-to-cart modal, bundle handling and `updateCart` already connected. And because the
916	resolver rewires imports transparently, overriding a component that SFCC's own base components
917	import means **the entire base template inherits your version with zero call sites touched**.
918	
919	Worked examples: size selector → `swatch-group`; add to bag → `product-view`; max quantity →
920	`quantity-picker`; variant resolution → `use-controlled-variations` / `use-derived-product`.
921	Check what the base already does before scoping — a ticket saying "Cart API integration is in
922	scope" may be describing a call the base already makes.
923	3. **Compose existing ui-kit atoms** into something new.
924	4. **Build a new component.** Rarest. Justify it.
925	
926	Before rung 4, check the registry (`.claude/registry/`) and grep `ui-kits/`.
927	
928	**What `shared/ui` is actually for:** Contentful renderers need *primitives*, not commerce
929	components. Every Contentful component on `develop` already pulls them in — `duplexSection`
930	(`Box`, `Text`), `collectionHero` (`Box`, `Button`, `Heading`, `Text`), `hotspotPopup`,
931	`imageText`, `heroBanner`. Upstream those resolve to bare Chakra.
932	
933	⚠️ **But the barrel is not the leverage play it looks like.** Overriding
934	`shared/ui/<Name>` to propagate branded styling into base cart/checkout/account **does not
935	work** — `shared/ui/index.jsx:29` re-exports relatively, which the resolver doesn't rewrite,
936	and 212 base files import the barrel (195 excluding tests) while **0** import the individual module. See
937	Part I §4.
938	
939	#### Figma stays open the whole time
940	
941	Not at the end. **And check the Jira card's Figma link actually points at your frame** — a
942	stale link propagates: you build the wrong thing, the BA signs off against a different frame,

1047	*The longest section, and the part that moves. Read it before your first component.*

1165	#### Register the recipe or it throws
1166	
1167	Chakra resolves a recipe by the string key passed to `useMultiStyleConfig`, not by file path.
1168	Co-location is therefore free — but the key must be in `theme/components/index.ts` or
1169	destructuring throws at runtime.

1172	automatically; a custom multipart component must call `useMultiStyleConfig` (or `useStyleConfig`
1173	for a single-part one). A registered-but-unread recipe looks like compliance and changes nothing.

1186	touch devices, keyboard focus, rapid pointer movement, SSR output, and re-render cost.

1806	#### The quality ceiling is set by the human
1807	
1808	An AI assistant has no standards of its own — the standards and the constraints are things you
1809	supply. Its real value is making your assumptions visible faster, not making decisions.

1811	#### The dual mandate
1812	
1813	You hold two hats and the failure mode is collapsing into one.

1816	|---|---|---|
